description.en:
This script adds an advanced settings menu allowing you to change the global diesel price based on real-world countries. Over 35 countries have been divided into categories. How to use: Go to the general game settings, find the "Realistic Diesel Price" section, first choose a region, and then select your preferred country. Changes apply immediately. Buying fuel from a placeable tank is more expensive than at a gas station. Supports multiplayer mode. Github: https://github.com/KryskiPL/FS25_RealisticDieselPrice
Available countries and prices (Euro/L):
Europe: - Poland PLN: 6.65 - Poland Euro: 1.55 - Lithuania: 1.79 - Latvia: 1.72 - Estonia: 1.66 - Czechia: 1.53 - Austria: 1.80 - Croatia: 1.55 - Slovakia: 1.55 - Hungary: 1.79 - Romania: 1.82 - Germany: 1.90 - United Kingdom: 1.96 - Ireland: 1.85 - Netherlands: 2.15 - Belgium: 1.95 - France: 1.95 - Italy: 2.00 - Spain: 1.57 - Switzerland: 2.25 - Portugal: 1.90 - Denmark: 2.07 - Norway: 1.61 - Sweden: 1.65 - Finland: 2.20 - Belarus: 0.80 - Ukraine: 1.53
Americas & Australia: - Brazil: 1.14 - Argentina: 1.30 - USA: 1.08 - Canada: 1.16 - Australia: 1.09
Asia: - Russia: 0.90 - Kazakhstan: 0.62 - Mongolia: 1.52 - China: 0.98 - Japan: 0.86
Changelog: 2.1.0.0: - Added a dynamic, two-step selection menu (Region selection -> Country selection). - Added 33 new countries and their fuel prices. - Updated all fuel prices as of 06.07.2026.
description.de:

description.pl:
Skrypt dodaje zaawansowane menu pozwalające na zmianę ceny diesla w oparciu o prawdziwe kraje. Ponad 35 państw w kategoriach.
